rule: Recognize architectural components before furniture. This inventory records source evidence and references to existing draft geometry, not a second mesh/scene format. Never turn a component into an unknown furniture block. Product acceptance follows user-visible walkthrough geometry rather than hidden BIM completeness.

types.label: 凸窗
types.handling: Reference the enclosing wall paths and hosted glazing once. The projection is not a cabinet or automatically walkable floor.

types.label: 窗台
types.handling: Record source evidence; do not create furniture or floor from a ledge.

types.label: 墙垛
types.handling: Reference its real wall runs once; do not add a second column/solid.

types.label: 独立柱
types.handling: Record a separate structural column when it affects the visible/walkable scene. Native Column exists but draft conversion does not yet import it; do not replace a visible column with furniture or hide a user-perceptible gap.

types.label: 管井／竖井
types.handling: Reference source-supported enclosure walls and do not invent access. A completely sealed technical cavity may keep an arbitrary internal slab/ceiling state when a walkthrough user cannot see, reach or interact with it and it does not alter visible wall faces or collision; that hidden BIM detail is intentionally out of scope and is not a blocking native-model gap.

types.label: 阳台／露台
types.handling: Default recognized balconies/terraces to independent enclosed rooms: trace the actual perimeter, reuse house-side walls once, and host glazing on outer straight/curved paths except observed solid piers. Declare policy-derived host/window IDs in assumptions; do not claim source-observed glazing or add a duplicate floorArea. Disclose unsupported perimeter gaps.

types.label: 设备平台
types.handling: Retain source evidence; do not extend living floor or furniture onto it. Hidden internal construction is out of scope unless it changes the visible/reachable scene.

types.label: 固定花池／种植平台
types.handling: Require a drawn built-in planting boundary; loose plant symbols alone do not establish a structural planter.

types.label: 栏杆／护栏
types.handling: Record observed guard evidence; no duplicate solid. Only a recognized balcony perimeter may host assumed full-height glazing under the declared default balcony enclosure policy; other railings do not become walls.

types.label: 楼梯
types.handling: Record tread/flight evidence and only visible up/down direction. Never infer the destination floor, rise or ceiling hole from a single symbol. Treat missing support as blocking only when it affects the requested visible/reachable walkthrough.

types.label: 挑空／楼板洞口
types.handling: Record an explicit user-visible or reachable void; never close it with an inferred walkable floor. Current draft-to-3D conversion has no void subtraction contract, so a visible/reachable void remains a real modeling gap.
